title: Extended chronological evaluation with intra-season folds

dataset.source: disposable DB (phase23_eval.db) from staged FD E0 CSVs

notes: Phase 26.8 extends Phase-25 with 2 intra-season folds split at the 2019/20 COVID-19 gap (2020-03-09) and mid-season (2019-12-29).
All 4 test sets are pairwise disjoint -- no double-counting in pooled metrics.
COVID-19 gap (2020-03-09 to 2020-06-17, 100 days) is a documented stationarity discontinuity.
No additional historical data was available locally; intra-season folds reuse the same verified 3-season E0 dataset.
Fast mode evaluates only Poisson, LR, and frequency baseline.
Production DB opened read-only and SHA-256 gated (fail-closed).
Only verified local data used -- no fabrication of matches, odds, or predictions.
